en.title: Ok Taec-yeon Update: Park Young-gwang's Brief, Fiery Friendship in Manager Kim

Young-gwang is Manager Kim's colleague and friend from the time they trained as agents for operations in the North. He does not drive the present-day case, but he is a key piece of the past that explains why Kim wants to protect his family and an ordinary life. Ok extended the impression of his brief appearance by personally sharing behind-the-scenes photos on his official Instagram account.…
